name: [HanLane] Telemetry ingest lag above 5 s
message: Telemetry reaches MongoDB {{value}} ms after it was read (t0 -> t2, 2 min average); normal is 0.2-0.5 s. MongoDB is not keeping up: Atlas M0 throttles around 100 documents per second. Check WRITE_MODE (single writes one document per call) and the vehicle count. Incident warnings are not affected: they have their own write path.
